description: One financial field for a European company, newest period first. Annual consolidated figures from ESEF annual reports of listed companies in 16 countries (BE, CY, DK, ES, FI, FR, GB, HR, HU, IS, LT, MT, NL, PT, SE, SK). Coverage excludes Germany, Ireland and Italy. One page via limit/cursor. Costs 1 credit. A figure can be withheld (null/absent beats a guess) and can change or disappear when a later filing arrives. Figures follow the source, including any adjustments described with the figure. This is filing data, not investment advice.

cursor.description: The meta.next_cursor of the previous page.
